Athletes, artists and leaders in the making.

Boarding, sport, arts, robotics, riding and more across 174 acres.

Boarding & care

A home away from home

Dorm design balances home and school so your child feels safe, happy and welcome.

Dormitories

Fully renovated; a delicate balance between home and school so your child feels safe, happy and welcome.

Dining hall

Renovated hall for 300 diners; five meals a day with menus designed by a dietician.

Prayer hall

Call to prayer five times a day; basic Islamic education and Quran recitation are emphasised.

Sick bay

A trained nurse on campus 24/7, regular doctor visits and in-house care.

Akbar Peerbhoy Sports Stadium

The largest sports ground in town, with separate grounds for football, kabaddi, volleyball and basketball.

Green campus

Rainwater harvesting and organic gardens across 174 acres of flora and fauna.

Student journey

How our students evolve

  1. 1

    Arrive & settle

    Orientation for new students, a welcome assembly and the dorm in-charge as the first point of contact.

  2. 2

    Build foundations

    Study habits, reading and core subjects, with peer tutors, advisors and regular unit tests.

  3. 3

    Explore passions

    Robotics, riding, archery, debate, pottery and sport — inter-house contests let every child shine.

  4. 4

    Rise to the board year

    Preliminary exams, practicals and one-to-one goal setting for Std X and XII.

  5. 5

    Launch

    NEET, JEE, CET, NATA and CA guidance, the Annual Day prize distribution and a farewell.
